name: Email and contact management
business_facts: Contact records are authoritative only in the verified primary-contact fields.
Records briefs are archived to the approved compliance mailbox only.
Confidential fields are never part of user-facing briefs.
Changes to contact ownership require the operations lead's approval.
Every mail record keeps a change history with actor and timestamp.
Approval decisions follow the documented policy: exceptions may be accepted when the named owner approves them and the decision records a business justification and a rollback plan.
